idea-plugin.name: Windows Key Labels for Mac
idea-plugin.description: On macOS, shows shortcut modifiers with Windows keyboard names (Ctrl, Win, Alt, Shift) instead of the macOS symbols ⌘ ⌃ ⌥ ⇧. For Windows keyboards connected to a Mac. Detects the connected keyboard and its macOS modifier key remapping; manual labels are the fallback. Labels are set in Settings | Appearance & Behavior | Windows Key Labels for Mac.
